records.title: XRP escrow schedule and post-release state at XRPL ledger 108038942

Tracker reports 1,000,000,000 XRP released on November 1; first EscrowFinish at 00:00:02 UTC.
Tracker reports no re-escrow by ledger 108038942, 30.4B XRP remaining in 96 escrow objects across eight owner accounts, and a 64.2% rolling 12-release re-escrow ratio.
